name: fixedQuery
label: Fixed query
description: Current fixed query conditions applied to the list.

name: maxColumns
label: Max Columns
description: Choose how many columns to display from the view or from the columns you selected. For example, if a view has 15 columns, you can choose to show only the first 5.

name: rowLimit
label: Row Limit
description: The max number of rows to show per page

name: requestId
label: Request ID
description: An ID to identify the request sent for fetching the list data.

name: featureFlags
label: Feature Flags
description: Collection of flags governing record list features

name: table
label: Table
description: The table data to display in the list

name: query
label: Query
description: Query condition to be applied to fetch the list

name: columns
label: Columns
description: The columns to display in the list

name: view
label: View
description: Preconfigured columns selection, as defined in the [sys_ui_view] table.

name: listId
label: List ID
description: Preconfigured columns selection, as defined in the [sys_ui_view] table.
